summary: iteration_5 (frontend/asset-only iteration: new NE Post & Polish raster logo applied to nav, footer, and favicon). Backend regression suite 20/20 green (unchanged). Frontend asset & UI checks all pass: (1) document.title is exactly 'NE Post & Polish | Mailbox Specialists'; (2) declares , , , meta description contains 'NE Post & Polish'; (3) direct HTTP fetch of /favicon.ico (200, 11033B), /logo-icon.png (200, 62399B), /apple-touch-icon.png (200, 30670B), /logo-primary.png (200, 268030B) — no 404s, correct content-types; (4) Nav renders inside data-testid=nav-logo, naturalWidth=760, loads over both the transparent dark hero and after scroll on the cream/bone backdrop, clicking scrolls window.scrollY back to 0; (5) Footer renders with naturalWidth=760 inside data-testid=site-footer; footer copyright reads '© 2026 NE Post & Polish' (CSS-uppercased for display); (6) Old text lockup ('Post', '&', 'Polish' spans) is gone from both nav-logo and footer — inner_text of nav-logo is empty (image only); (7) Mobile 390x844 viewport: nav logo box (x=24, w=110.9) does not overlap mobile toggle (x=344), toggle opens data-testid=nav-mobile-panel with all 6 links + Get a quote CTA rendering cleanly, nav-logo click returns to top; no horizontal overflow observed; (8) no console errors during load. Logo is legible at both desktop and mobile — eggshell enamel-plate badge with maroon serif 'NE Post & Polish' wordmark, navy brush stroke, wood-grain post with Fire Pit brown cap all rendering as designed. Booking + admin regression skipped this iteration because no code path changed vs iteration_4 (which was fully green); backend suite still exercises the full lead CRUD + auth + brute-force flow end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — should migrate to FastAPI lifespan handlers (deprecation warnings only, non-blocking).

Landing.js/BookingForm.js service-option data-testids derived from option text via split(' —')[0].toLowerCase() are fragile — consider stable keys on SERVICE_OPTIONS entries (carried over from iteration_4).
Logo.js: img has no explicit width/height attributes — could cause minor CLS on slow connections. Consider adding intrinsic dimensions (natural 760x329) or a fixed aspect-ratio wrapper.
Legacy 'Diag Test' leads with retired 'The Standard — replacement' service label still persist in MongoDB from earlier iterations — visible in admin dashboard; recommend one-time cleanup or reseed.
